item.summary: Union Minister of Commerce and Industry Shri Piyush Goyal concluded his official visit to the Arab Republic of Egypt from 15 to 16 November 2026. The visit marked his first bilateral visit to an African country. During the visit, the Minister held a series of high-level bilateral meetings, co-chaired the 7th Session of the India–Egypt Joint Trade Committee (JTC), participated in business…
item.title: India and Egypt reaffirm commitment to strengthen bilateral trade, investment and industrial cooperation
